messages:
emma_support: FYI AcmeCorp reported invoice `INV-2026-02-28-ACME-449` showing ~120,000 extra tokens compared to the dashboard snapshot at 2026-03-01T00:10Z. They attached CSV with two near-identical shipments around 2026-02-28 23:59:58 UTC and 2026-03-01 00:00:03 UTC. Anyone seeing retry/dedupe gaps on ingest?

tara_billing: Can you drop invoice id, customer_id, plan tier, and the dashboard snapshot export? I need those to start a provisional credit calc.

mike_sre: Noted. I'll check metering-ingest and CDC windows. We had a regression where client retries without idempotency keys could be double-written if the CDC consumer lag exceeded ~30s.

metering-bot: deploy: ingest-service v1.14.3 at 2026-02-28T23:58:50Z commit=9a1b2c rollout=100%
metering-bot: ingest-consumer processed 5.2k msgs between 2026-02-28T23:57:00Z and 2026-03-01T00:02:00Z (lag spike ~38s)

kevin_engineer: Running quick counts for customer_id `acme-449` between 2026-02-28T23:55:00Z and 2026-03-01T00:05:00Z. Query I ran: 

```sql
SELECT date_trunc('minute', received_at) AS minute,
       count(*) AS total_events,
       count(distinct request_id) AS distinct_request_ids,
       sum(tokens) AS tokens
FROM metering_events
WHERE customer_id = 'acme-449'
  AND received_at >= '2026-02-28T23:55:00Z'
  AND received_at <  '2026-03-01T00:05:00Z'
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1;
```

kevin_engineer: Results (trimmed):
- 2026-02-28 23:59:00: total_events=4,200 distinct_request_ids=2,150 tokens=119,480
- 2026-03-01 00:00:00: total_events=8,400 distinct_request_ids=2,150 tokens=238,960

kevin_engineer: Distinct request_id count stays the same while total_events and tokens double — suggests duplicate writes where request_id was NULL/empty for many events or request_id normalization failed.

anna_finance: The invoice shows two separate line items billed under `standard-gen` for 2026-02-28 23:59 and 2026-03-01 00:00. Aggregator collapsed by billing window but didn't dedupe. That matches the customer's CSV.

emma_support: Customer says they saw timeouts in their client and retried. They are on SDK v0.9.2 which doesn't set our new idempotency header by default. They attached a sample request log with repeated body + missing `X-Request-ID`.

mike_sre: Proposed immediate actions: 
1) Dry-run a dedupe backfill removing duplicates by (customer_id, request_id) where request_id IS NOT NULL, plus (customer_id, event_hash) dedupe window 5 minutes for NULL request_id.
2) Add temporary ledger hold/ignore of duplicate window for invoice generation for affected invoice if backfill confirms double-bill.
3) Long-term: server-side dedupe on ingest and alert on duplicate ratio.

metering-bot: backfill-dryrun scheduled: bf-dryrun-acme-20260301 at 2026-03-01T01:10:00Z job_id=bf-20260301-01

kevin_engineer: Dry-run summary (run id bf-dryrun-acme-20260301): dedupe removed 118,432 tokens from billing cohort for acme-449 in the target window. Query used for final tally: `SELECT SUM(tokens) FROM metering_events WHERE duplicated = true AND backfill_run = 'bf-dryrun-acme-20260301';`

anna_finance: That's large. Tara, recommend one-time customer credit for 118,432 tokens (use current USD token rate). Approve provisional credit while engineering completes backfill.

tara_billing: Approving provisional credit. Please provide exact USD amount in this thread once you have the tokens->USD calc. Also note ledger entry id to reconcile after final backfill.

emma_support: Draft customer note for review: 

"Hi Acme team — thanks for flagging. Root cause: client-side retries combined with older SDK that didn't include idempotency keys, plus a short CDC lag that allowed duplicate ingestion. We've removed duplicate events from billing and issued a provisional credit of ~118.4k tokens to your account. Please upgrade to SDK v1.x or set X-Request-ID to avoid replays. We're also adding server-side dedupe. Apologies for the disruption." :pray:

mike_sre: Follow-ups created: ENG-METER-3426 (server-side dedupe + 2-week backfill window), OBS-MET-1289 (alert for duplicate token ratio > 1%), and OPS-MISC-990 (billing ledger hold for backfill reconciliations). PR opened: https://git.redwood/eng/metering/pull/998

kevin_engineer: I pushed the backfill job (safe mode) and will run final reconcile once ingest fix merges. Backfill dryrun log excerpt: `removed_tokens=118432 candidate_refunds=1 status=success`

tara_billing: Ledger entry created provisional_credit_2776543210 amount_usd="$1,042.78" (this is provisional). Will finalize after final backfill.

emma_support: I pinged Acme and sent the draft message + provisional credit notice. Customer asked for ETA — told them EOD for final confirmation.

mike_sre: I'll prioritize the ingest dedupe PR. Expected merge + deploy within 24h. After deploy, I'll re-run final backfill and post final numbers.

emma_support: Marking thread status: pending (credits queued, customer notified, engineering follow-up). Will close after PR merge and ledger finalization.

tara_billing: Thanks all. Excellent cross-team response.
